name: How long does a roof moisture intrusion assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a roof moisture intrusion assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof moisture intrusion assessment typically ranges from 1 to 3 hours, depending on the size and complexity of your roof. Larger or multi-level roofs, or those requiring extensive use of thermal imaging and moisture meters for thorough investigation, will take longer. We aim to complete assessments efficiently while ensuring a comprehensive analysis of your roofing system.
acceptedAnswer.description: An assessment typically takes 1 to 3 hours, varying by roof size and complexity, ensuring thorough analysis.
